seo.title: Every Man Jack: predictive replenishment with Klaviyo - 12.4% of email revenue (2024)
seo.meta_description: Every Man Jack times its replenishment reminders to the date predicted by Klaviyo AI and draws 12.4% of its Klaviyo-attributed revenue from it over 90 days.
seo.resume_citable: Every Man Jack generated 12.4% of its Klaviyo-attributed revenue over 90 days by triggering its replenishment emails on the next order date predicted by Klaviyo AI, with +25% revenue from flows in one year.

faq.q: Which AI does Every Man Jack use?
faq.a: Klaviyo AI (predictive analytics), which predicts each subscriber's next order date from their purchase history.
12.4% of Klaviyo-attributed revenue generated by the predictive segments over 90 days, and a 25% year-over-year rise in revenue from flows.

pattern: predictive replenishment timing (predicted next order date)
objectif_business: Increase retention revenue on personal care products by triggering replenishment reminders when the customer is actually about to run out, rather than at a fixed interval.
description: Every Man Jack sells men's personal care direct and through Target and Whole Foods, for more than 100 million dollars in annual revenue. The old email tool sent the replenishment reminder at 45 days, while customers actually reorder closer to 75 days. Klaviyo AI computes a next order date for each subscriber from their history and consumption pace, and the team times the replenishment flow to that individual date. The reminder goes out when the customer is expected to reach the end of their product.
points_cles: Replenishment reminders timed to the predicted next order date per customer.
Klaviyo AI (predictive analytics) and Klaviyo flows, self-service.
12.4% of Klaviyo-attributed revenue over 90 days, +25% revenue from flows over a year.
Evidence level B, confirmed active status.

resultats.metrique: Share of Klaviyo revenue generated by the predictive segments (90 days)
Revenue from automated flows, year over year

niveau_preuve.justification: Two quantified and consistent Klaviyo publications (a dedicated customer story and an official blog naming the brand and the 12.4%). No independent press source, hence B rather than C.

stack_technique.detail: CRM and email platform that holds customer profiles, segments, and automated flows.
Computes for each subscriber the predicted next order date from their purchase history and consumption pace.
The replenishment flow triggers on each customer's predicted date instead of the old tool's fixed 45-day interval.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Near real time per subscriber: the flow triggers on each customer's predicted date, recomputed as purchases come in.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Retention marketing team (one person leads it at Every Man Jack), on Klaviyo in self-service.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The predicted next order date. If the purchase history per customer is too thin or poorly tied to the profile, the prediction degrades and the reminder falls back to a generic interval.

etapes.detail: Purchases and email engagement feed the customer profile in Klaviyo.
The model predicts each subscriber's likely next order date.
The team sets the replenishment flow to go out on the predicted date or slightly before, instead of the fixed 45-day interval.
The reminder goes out at the right time; the customer's reaction feeds back into the profile and refines the next prediction.

prerequis_data: per-customer purchase history tied to a single profile
repeat-consumption products with an identifiable replenishment cycle
prerequis_orga: one person on the CRM side who runs the flows
products with predictable replenishment in the catalog
stack_possible: any email/CRM platform with replenishment date prediction (native predictive analytics)
replication.premiere_etape: Check that the email platform computes a next order date per customer, then wire the replenishment flow to it instead of a fixed interval.

playbook.action: Check that the purchase history is tied to a single profile per customer.
Enable predictive analytics and check the predicted dates on a sample.
playbook.livrable: Next order dates available and consistent

playbook.action: Rewire the replenishment flow to the predicted date instead of the fixed interval.
Compare to the fixed interval (A/B or before-after) and measure revenue per flow.
playbook.livrable: Quantified read on the gain and extension to the predictive segments

statut_vivant.note: Every Man Jack is still cited as a Klaviyo AI customer in the vendor's current content. The pattern (replenishment flow timed to the predicted date) is a standard Klaviyo feature.

transposable_ue.note: The replenishment date predictions rely on individual purchase history. In the EU, the legal basis for profiling and email consent needs framing (GDPR), but nothing is blocking in principle.
